content:
《Ted Lasso》has returned (watch here) for its highly anticipated fourth season, and Apple TV executive Eddy Cue recently hinted that the show still has a long and bright future ahead after this season.

Eddy Cue said that 《Ted Lasso》 "has many more stories to tell," and there's absolutely no problem with continuing for several more seasons.

Apple has not yet officially confirmed a fifth season of 《Ted Lasso》, but all signs indicate that beyond the currently airing fourth season, at least two more seasons will be produced.

Deadline reported last year that the cast has signed three-season deals, reportedly aligning with Jason Sudeikis's rumored vision for a new three-season storyline.

Now, with the show's return, Apple's services chief Eddy Cue was asked about his thoughts on a fifth season and beyond.

In a red carpet interview with ScreenRant, when discussing the possibility of a fifth season of 《Ted Lasso》, Cue said:

Although Cue did not confirm any specific plans, he was essentially saying that Apple will continue the 《Lasso》 franchise as long as there's an opportunity.

This comes as no surprise, but it's still encouraging to hear. In other words, the day we have to say goodbye to these characters is hopefully still very far away.

《Ted Lasso》 season 4 drops new episodes every Wednesday, wrapping up on October 7. Two episodes are already available on Apple TV.

Are you excited about the return of 《Ted Lasso》? What are your thoughts on the new season? Let us know in the comments.
